evidence.quote: On my return I received your’s of Oct. 6th. for which very many thanks.
I am vastly amused with your not recognizing the author of the cattle hunt in Ross Voy
Whoever the officer was, to my taste he is a first-rate describer
Do my dear Darwin take a fools advice & drop the battle about perpetuity of names
